configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Matches the long-lived incremental build in build/: Ninja, Homebrew LLVM clang, project-default options. Do NOT delete build/ to 'apply' this preset — it exists so `cmake --preset default` reproduces the same configuration.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Separate TSan build tree for concurrency work. First configure refetches/rebuilds deps (SDL_shadercross/DXC) — slow; keep build-tsan/ alive afterwards just like build/. Examples and benchmarks are off: the TSan lane runs bracken_tests.

configurePresets.name: rel
configurePresets.description: RelWithDebInfo tree — the only lane that exercises the NDEBUG path, where BRACKEN_ASSERT and the debug-only thread-tier assertions compile out. Run it before shipping any change that relies on an assert for correctness. Coexists with build/ and build-tsan/.

configurePresets.name: bench
configurePresets.description: Optimized tree for bracken_benchmarks. The default build/ tree has no CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE, so it compiles at -O0 with live asserts — any number measured there is meaningless. Always benchmark here.
